system.description:
Use this skill when a target other than yourself begins their Main Process. You may immediately use one [Target: Self] [Charm], with the target of the Charm changing to the target of this skill.

(Fate 1 & Self: Talismancer, Rune Knight): If you have reached your Limit for this skill, you may pay this cost to use it again.

A special skill that uses the effects of amulets on others. You can cast amulets on distant opponents by throwing them, projecting spells, and so on.
